newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica boosted by mobiles, international business.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica boosted by mobiles, international business.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana said on Monday its international and mobile businesses were growing strongly.
"International business continues to grow strongly, in its size as well as in its contribution to total group results," Telefonica said in a statement on its first-quarter results.
Net attributable profit at the newly privatised group jumped 15.7 percent to 27.87 billion pesetas in the first quarter.

Telefonica said revenues from abroad reached 108.46 billion pesetas, a rise of 46.7 percent. Telefonica International's contribution to the group's total revenues was 17.3 percent, a rise of three percentage points over the same period in 1996.
The number of clients at its mobile telephone sector rose to 2.55 million, up 110.8 percent over the year-ago period.
Revenues from Telefonica Moviles reached 13.2 percent from 9.5 percent in the first quarter of 1996.
